end.summary:
Navya retold the main events of “The Cap-seller and the Monkeys.”
They answered where the cap-seller slept and what happened to the caps.
They explained that the monkeys copied the cap-seller by throwing their caps.
Teach-back was not passed; one unaided who/what/where response was incorrect.
end.parentNote: Asha practised story sequencing and who, what, and where questions with Navya. Navya used the copy idea to explain why the monkeys threw their caps, and this was clarified during the lesson. At home, ask Navya to retell the story using three prompts: where, what happened next, and how it ended.
